chapter: Alma Hightower and other women musicians
title: Meeting Alma Hightower while both cleaned at Bullock's
summary: Howard recalls that Hightower also did janitor work at Bullock's and he only learned she was a musician when they played; she was a drummer.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
